problem.title: Merge Intervals
problem.statement: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping intervals that cover all of the input. Intervals that touch (one ends where the next starts) overlap. Return them in any order.

events.text: Up to 10^4 intervals, unsorted, and touching ones like [1,4],[4,5] count as overlapping. I'll sort by start, then extend the last merged interval while the next one starts before it ends. Can you check the idea before I code it?
That approach works and meets the target complexity. Watch the order of your updates.
For touching intervals, should my overlap check be start <= last_end or start < last_end?
Good catch to ask. Yes, that case matters; handle it explicitly before updating your state.
Which edge cases should I plan for: a single interval, one containing another, touching ends?
Those are the right ones to test; your plan covers them if the update order is right.
